# GlobalCalc Pro

> GlobalCalc Pro provides free, high-precision financial, health, real estate, and mathematical calculators.

GlobalCalc Pro offers over 20+ specialized calculators for financial planning, loan amortization, health metrics, and unit conversions, optimized for human users and AI agents.

## Core Calculators

- [All Calculators](https://globalcalcpro.com/en/all): Browse all financial, health, and math calculators
- [Mortgage Calculator](https://globalcalcpro.com/en/mortgage-calculator): Calculate monthly mortgage payments, interest, and loan terms
- [Compound Interest Calculator](https://globalcalcpro.com/en/compound-interest): Compute investment growth with monthly contributions
- [Percentage Finder](https://globalcalcpro.com/en/percentage-finder): Find percentages, percentage change, and discounts
- [Unit Converter](https://globalcalcpro.com/en/unit-converter): Convert length, weight, temperature, area, and speed
- [BMI Calculator](https://globalcalcpro.com/en/bmi-calculator): Calculate Body Mass Index and healthy weight range
- [Salary Calculator](https://globalcalcpro.com/en/salary-calculator): Convert hourly pay to annual salary and net take-home
- [Tip & Bill Splitter](https://globalcalcpro.com/en/tip-calculator): Split restaurant bills and calculate gratuity

## Supported Languages

- [English Calculators](https://globalcalcpro.com/en/all): English version of all tools
- [Hebrew Calculators](https://globalcalcpro.com/he/all): Hebrew (RTL) version of all tools
- [Spanish Calculators](https://globalcalcpro.com/es/all): Spanish version of all tools
- [Arabic Calculators](https://globalcalcpro.com/ar/all): Arabic (RTL) version of all tools
